# Next Comes Calm

> Next Comes Calm sells printable "visual schedule" and calm-preparation kits for children ages 2-8, helping parents prepare kids — especially autistic, ADHD, and sensory-sensitive kids — for hard or unfamiliar moments like dentist visits, haircuts, school mornings, and vaccinations. Each kit is an instant-download PDF with a visual visit plan, a First-Then-Next board, a comfort plan, and communication cards. Kits are sold on Etsy (nextcomescalm.etsy.com); prices below are in Canadian dollars (CAD).
